towns-and-towers.title: Towns and Towers
towns-and-towers.description: Spice up your world with new villages, pillager outposts, and even new ships!
towns-and-towers.body:
AS OF RIGHT NOW, TOWNS AND TOWERS IS AVAILABLE FOR BOTH FORGE AND FABRIC/QUILT, VERSIONS 1.18.2 AND 1.19.2 RESPECTIVELY. WORKS SERVERSIDE.
FROM VERSION 1.19.3 AND ABOVE (ALL THE WAY TO 1.20.4), THE PACK IS DEPENDANT ON CRISTELLIB, STILL WORKING SERVERSIDE.


Also available on CurseForge, as well as on Planet Minecraft (as a datapack)!

 

 

What is Towns and Towers?

     Towns & Towers is a mod that aims to expand upon the 1.14 update created by Mojang with new villages, pillager outposts, and even brand-new ships. The structures themselves are a bit more detailed than their vanilla counterparts, but they still fit seamlessly into the world. Not only that but many are inspired by real-life buildings or architectural styles, giving them a fresh new feel. There are over 50 structures added by Towns and Towers so far (as of update 1.9), so have fun exploring! And remember, it’s not the destination that’s important, but the journey to get there.

     If you wish to see all of the structures our mod adds, take a look at our gallery here.

 

Compatibility

     For a full list of mods that are currently compatible with Towns and towers, please look here.

     The pack should be compatible with most world generation mods, like Terralith, WWOO, BYG, BoP, etc., as well as mods that add also add new structures/villages, such as Repurposed Structures or ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages. However, some features from other mods are not currently present, like the guards from Villager Guards mod or certain buildings from Farmer's Delight for example. This will be addressed in the future via a series of datapacks, which will implement features from those mods into ours.

 

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Is it safe to update Towns and Towers to a newer version?

     In general yes. Just note that sometimes when we update a few things get changed, so there might be a bit of console spam. If any serious problems arise because of that, let us know. And, as always, make backups. Better be safe than sorry.
 

2. Is it safe to add Towns and Towers to an already existing world?

     Yep. Just note that the new structures will only spawn in newly generated chunks.
 

3. Is this mod for Forge or Fabric/Quilt?

     Both. We have a universal version for both (now three?) mod loaders.
 

4. How can I locate the new structures?

     For 1.18.2: /locate towns_and_towers:[structure_from_list]
     For 1.19+: /locate structure towns_and_towers:[structure_from_list]
     Note that some structures have the exclusives tag added in front. Those structures cannot be located if you only have T&T installed. You also need to have one of the mods that T&T is paired with. For a full list, scroll down below (if I remember to add it...).
 

5. Does Towns and Towers modify existing vanilla structures?

     As of the latest update, no. Only new structures are added.
 

6. What about the loot of these structures?

     The majority of structures use vanilla loot tables for better mod compatibility (see the Compatibility section below for more info), but they also use some custom loot tables to better integrate said structures into the world. You will still find pillager outpost loot in pillager outposts, profession chests in villages, as well as bells, workstations, etc., but also new stuff like food, armor, and other goodies.
 

7. How can I report bugs/issues/suggestions?

     Write them down below in the comments and I’ll try to answer them as soon as possible and as best as possible. I’m still relatively new to all of this, so excuse that.
 

8. Can I include Towns and Towers into my modpack?

     Sure, but make sure to give credit and a link to our page, and make sure you don't include a modified version of our mod.
 

9. 1.16.5???

     https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DTvrv4f3Yho

 

Credits

  • Kubek as the original author of Towns and Towers;
  • William Wythers, ChoiceTheorem, Apollo, Robified and TelepathicGrunt for being based;
  • Various other creators and their builds for being a massive inspiration (check out our Planet Minecraft page here for a full list)

    If you find any glitches, bugs or have any other suggestions, please let us know. We'll have a bug report page soon (hopefully).

dungeons-and-taverns.title: Dungeons and Taverns
dungeons-and-taverns.description: A Structure Datapack adding dungeons, taverns and other structures to find while you explore the world.
dungeons-and-taverns.body:
This datapacks adds (hopefully) vanilla like structures that are supposed to blend in with the rest of the game and feel like they belong there. going from environmental additions like fire watch towers and taverns to dungeons like badland minder outpost and illager hideout

### **WARNING: It has been discovered recently that someone(s) made a malicious website claiming to be the official website for Dungeons and Taverns, when in actuality it host malware!!!**
The **_ONLY_** official places for all things Dungeons and Taverns are the [Modrinth page of the creator](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra), the [Curseforge page of the creator](https://www.curseforge.com/members/nova_wostra/projects), and the [Witches Cauldron Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/fPvvmcnKza).

**To unlock maps at a tavern, you need to trade with the cateographer inside a tavern and level them up to aprentice. after that you can "move" them to wherever you want and keep leveling them up to unlock new charts**

**To remove Structures you dont like, go to "Dnt/data/nova_structures/worldgen/structure_set/" and delete the file of the structure you dont want.**

**To see the custom key textures, while using the datapack version, Install DnT also as a resourcepack. It's a 2 in one file
The Mod version loads those resources automatically
**

Various new enchantments can be found with this datapack, all being unique structure loot. This is the current information for 5.0+, as such it may not be accurate to prior versions of DnT.

List of enchantments:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Aerial's Bane
- Increased damage to targets that are up in the air; be that from knockback, jumping, or falling. Also works against Breezes, Vexes, and Withers.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces, Bows, Crossbows
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Damage boosting enchants like Sharpness and Power
- Found in: Lone Citadel, Sealing Halls, End Castle

Antidote
- Negates all damage from Poison and Wither effects and deals it to the chestplate.
- Items: Chestplates
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Protection enchantments
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Blowthrough
- Is equal to the Piercing enchant, but works exclsuviely for Bows
- Items: Bows
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: Infinity, Tri-shot
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Curse of Conductivity
- Gives a chance to get struck by lightning during a thunderstorm when held or equipped
- Items: Any "metallic" item :)
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Witch Villa

Ghasted
- Arrows transform into Ghast fireballs, while slowing crossbow charge time. Higher levels increase fireballs' explosions.
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Multishot, Piercing, Might, Aerial's Bane
- Found in: Sealing Halls

Gravity
- Shoot an arrow which pulls all mobs around it upon landing, destroying the arrow in the process
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: End Castle

Hydro Veil
- Increases Happy Ghast healing to match rain / cloud layer healing, except when in the Nether. Also takes less damage from fire and explosions per level.
- Items: Harnesses
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Nether Keep, Sealing Halls

Illager's Bane
- Increased damage against illagers, ravgers, vexes, and witches.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Damage enchants like Sharpness
- Found in: Illager Manor, Illager Hideout

Outreach
- Increases block interaction range per level, allowing you to place or break blocks from farther.
- Items: Chestplate
- Max level: 4
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Desert Ruins

Photosynthesis
- Restores the item's durability while the user is under sunlight from the sky or in block light that can grow crops.
- Items: Any with durability
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Mending
- Found in: Jungle Ruins

Might
- Boosts the arrows damage equal to Power enchantment, but applicable to Crossbows.
- Items: Crossbow
- Max level: 5
- Incompatible with: Gravity, Ghasted, Piercing, Multishot
- Found in: Lone Citadel

Spiteful
- Users with 2.5 hearts or less are given a attack damage boost per enchant level. If hit by a mob at any health there's a small chance to receive Strength.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Pale Residence, certain Shrines...

Swift Soar
- Boosts the Happy Ghast's flying speed while the rider is considered sprinting.
- Items: Harnesses
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: N/A
- Found in: Nether Port, Nether Keep, Sealing Halls

Traveler
- Boosts movement speed and step height while sprinting. Slowly drains durability while doing so.
- Items: Boots
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Soul Speed
- Found in: Shrines, random graves found in DnT structures

Tri-shot
- Is equal to Multishot in effect, but applicable to Bows
- Items: Bows
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Infinity, Piercing, Multishot
- Found in: Toxic Lair

Wax Wings
- Negates elytra damage from slow gliding, but raises durability drain from firework boosting.
- Items: Elytra
- Max level: 1
- Incompatible with: Unbreaking
- Found in: End Castle

Wither Coated
- Inflicts Wither effect to direct hit foes. Higher levels boost potency but lowers duration. In practice, this causes the same amount of Wither damage but faster with higher levels.
- Each attack also reduces item durability by 1.
- Items: Swords, Axes, Tridents, Maces
- Max level: 3
- Incompatible with: Fire Aspect
- Found in: Nether Port, Sealing Halls



</details>


Secret Librarian Trades 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

With this datapack, certain DnT structures will award a librarian villager with an exclusive trade if they're leveled up from novice to apprentice while inside certain structures, thus allowing many enchantments to be renewable. Can only get one enchantment at a time. The potential structures are listed below.
- Desert Ruins: Outreach
- End Castle: Aerial's Bane, Gravity, Wax Wings
- Illager Hideout: Illager's Bane
- Illager Manor: Illager's Bane
- Jungle Ruins: Photosynthesis
- Nether Keep: Hydro Veil, Swift Soar, Wither Coated
- Nether Port: Swift Soar
- Pale Residence: Spiteful
- Piglin Donjon: Soul Speed
- Sealing Halls: Aerial's Bane, Ghasted, Hydro Veil, Swift Soar, Wither Coated
- Lone Citadel: Wind Burst, Aerial's Bane, Might
- Toxic Lair: Antidote, Blowthrough, Tri-shot
- Shrines: Traveler
- Shrine Tower: Traveler
- Bunker: Traveler
- Undead Crypt: Traveler
- Witch Villa: Curse of Conductivity
- Ancient City (requires the DnT Ancient City Overhaul): Swift Sneak

</details>

gallery.title: Taverns
gallery.description: Taverns are places where you find beds and a Trader selling maps to some of the dungeons or ruins of this datapack. you need to level the villager, while they are inside the tavern, up to aprentice, to make them a tavern cartographer.

gallery.title: Firewatch towers
gallery.description: They are atmospheric builds to make the world feel more lived in. you can use them as a small base or just to find a nights rest

gallery.title: Mangrove Swamp Hut
gallery.description: the witches moved into the mangrove swamp with 3 different hut styles

gallery.title: Illager Hideout
gallery.description: A rare underground Dungeon that is filled with Illagers. a challenge for late game player who seek a challenge

gallery.title: Wild Ruins
gallery.description: Under wild ruins fall things like small camps, huts and dead redstone golems, they are environmental and supposed to add to making the world feel more lived in

gallery.title: Undead Crypts
gallery.description: Another underground Dungeon with alot of bones, skulls and other stuff with 1 spawner room

gallery.title: Underground House
gallery.description: 'tis but a terraria reference

gallery.title: Wells
gallery.description: why should the desert be the only place to have unnecessary wells?

gallery.title: Conduit ruin
gallery.description: A way to teach player how to build a conduit with hints in the chest in the prismarine ring as well as being an archeological site

gallery.title: Badlands Miner Outpost
gallery.description: This unique Outpost is more about the mining operations in Badlands. a good way to get gold and tnt

gallery.title: Jungle Ruins
gallery.description: You aren't a fan of the small Jungle temple? maybe search for Jungle ruins then.  Bogged spawn here and you can find the Photosynthesis Enchantment here

gallery.title: Witch Villa
gallery.description: Spawning in swamp biomes and Mangrove Swamps those structure act as witches woodland mansion with their own experiments and own backyard

gallery.title: Ruined Towns
gallery.description: Ruined Towns are ruins from the past with rubble everywhere with suspicious gravel holding mostly just junk but maybe some sherds and other tressures

gallery.title: Swamp Villages
gallery.description: Find villages in swamp with... witches? seems like getting that mending librarian isn't going to be that easy.

gallery.title: Jungle Villages
gallery.description: Spawning in Jungles are now jungle villages

gallery.title: Bunker
gallery.description: A somewhat rare structure that resembles surface exposed strongholds, they have a bigger room variety and dont have an end portal chamber

gallery.title: Piglin Donjon
gallery.description: The Donjon is a Megastructure spawning rarely in crimson forest biomes containing several room types of the various bastion remnants and container crates filled with gold. also look out for hidden vault rooms. Ontop is a Coloseum for Vault keys

gallery.title: End Ships
gallery.description: Lone Endships spawning within the end containing a vault needing an End Ship Vault Key. Those vaults always hold Elytra. Maybe even enchanted with Wax Wings

gallery.title: End Lighthouse
gallery.description: Structures spawning in the End acting as Ends version of Taverns. you can find maps here for End Castles and obtain End Ship Keys

gallery.title: End Castle
gallery.description: Ends version of a Stronghold and Endcity Hybrid. you can find Gravity, Wax Wings, End Ship Keys, End Crystals and other things here. can be found either with an End Castle Map or Eyes of Ender

gallery.title: Shrines
gallery.description: Shrines leading down to 1-5 themed combat arenas that all follow 1 theme per shrine, amound of copper bulbs indicate how many rooms there are. you can find Shrine Keys, Ominous Shrine keys and Traveler here. Ominous vaults are only in lv 5 shrines

gallery.title: Toxic Lair
gallery.description: Swamp Structure found in swamp biomes. Surface area has ruins with suspicious gravel but the inside leads to an underground structure with a miniboss and several trial spawner/vaults and ominous vaults. you can find Antidote, Piercing/Multishot bows here

gallery.title: Triden Trail Monument
gallery.description: Grant Prismarine structure not spawning guardians naturally but from trial spawner here, you can obtain tridents, heart of the sea and other goodies here

gallery.title: Lone Citadel
gallery.description: Probably Dungeons and Taverns biggest structure yet. Recreating the Lone Fortress from Minecraft Dungeons and bringing it to vanilla. Breezes and Strays are at home here. you can obtain the Might Enchantment and Aerials Bane here

gallery.title: Creeping Crypt
gallery.description: Creeping Crypts are an structure found in taiga biomes, filled with creeper, gunpowder, suspicious gravel and if you are lucky, even an creeper spawner alongside the other trial spawner spawning creepr and undead

gallery.title: Nether Keep
gallery.description: This Mega Structure is an giant tower spawning inside the nether, containing 3 blaze spawner rooms with their own treasure chests. bridges hold trialspawner and arenas to obtain keys for the vault inside. you can obtain a chart for the Sealing Halls here.

gallery.title: Remnants
gallery.description: Remnants are rare enviromental ruins, not different from wild ruins but MUCH MUCH rarer. one of them is a classic village that is abandoned

gallery.title: Illager Camp
gallery.description: A small somewhat rare camp with a few decorations spreaded around the main campfire, has a chest with a chart for a pillager outpost

gallery.title: Piglin Camp
gallery.description: Piglin Camps are somewhat common structures holding gold ore and charts to Hamlets

gallery.title: Hamlets
gallery.description: Hamlets are a Piglin structure with a Piglin village and apartment complex inside its underground part. They contain magma slime trial spawner and vaults that hold charts for Piglin Outstations

gallery.title: Piglin Outstation
gallery.description: Piglin Outstation are a rare Piglin Structure that are very inspired by the "Horde of the Bastion" Outpost in Minecraft legends as well as the vault rooms in Minecraft Dungeons Ancients Raids. They contain Vaults with charts for the Piglin Donjon.

gallery.title: Nether Skeleton Towers
gallery.description: Those Encampments spawn with skeletons and wither skeletons and hold chest to other biome types of the Nether Skeleton Tower and 1 chest with a chart for a Nether Port. Mobs do not respawn.

gallery.title: Nether Ports
gallery.description: Nether Ports are a Nether Skeleton structure that always generates at lava level with a central structure and ports with towers spawning around it, it contains trial spawner and vaults with the Swift Soar enchantments and 1 Chart for the Nether Keep

gallery.title: Sealing Halls
gallery.description: Acting as the Nether Skeletons Equaliment to the Piglin Donjon, this structure is the rarest DnT Nether structure and you can find all DnT Nether Enchantments here as well as a trial spawner with Ominous Consequences.

gallery.title: Stray Fort
gallery.description: Rare structure that generates in cold biomes and spawns more strays than usual during the night. You can find a chart for the Lone Citadel here.

gallery.title: Stray Outlook
gallery.description: rare structure that spawns in cold biomes with either spruce or stone walls. you can obtain a Stray Fort Chart here

gallery.title: Catacombs
gallery.description: Underground Deepslate structure that spawns, in cold biomes, under y level 0. No notable loot besides skulls if you like skulls.

gallery.title: Cave Chambers
gallery.description: Cave Chambers are the wild ruins of the underground. they spawn with a working fake cave system around them to integrate themself naturally in the underground worldgen. sometimes they have Vaults that require Cave Chamber Keys. some have trial spawners.

gallery.title: Trial Dungeon
gallery.description: Underground structure with 1 guranteed Spawner and 1-8 Trial spawner, adabt to cave gen with the same system as cave chambers and also spawn with vaults that require Cave Chamber Keys. the spawner there do give those out sometimes.

gallery.title: Illager Manor
gallery.description: Illager manor is a gigantic Dark oak/spruce wood structure spawning in old grown taigas or pine forest biomes. they are even rarer than woodland mansions but they do have the Illagers Bane enchantment.

kogtyv-tav.title: kogtyv-Towny and Village
kogtyv-tav.description: Changes the generation of villages to the generation of cities.
kogtyv-tav.body:
This mod adds miniature cities, villages and structures to your world. Currently, there are several types of structures: city "USSR", city "Europe", village "Saman", village "Greeks", structure "Pyramid". These structures are generated in plain, birch forest, taiga and desert biomes. The buildings are generated in different ways, the layout of the rooms has many variations, there are also external decorations of the houses. The game itself chooses which variation to generate. Everything is assembled using jigsaw blocks into a single structure. 

**The theme of the USSR city** - is old Soviet panel houses, with factories and stores, you can also find monuments, fountains, flowerbeds and parks. The cities were built up very densely. /locate ussr_medium_mix 
![The USSR City](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xXClL8T5/images/e7a0cf812a0eccf6579ebbad9b6fb1cb7da5cc7c.png)

**Europe city theme** - Old architectural houses from the Middle Ages, the cities are usually small in size, they have no factories and businesses, only small stores, fountains and markets. /locate europe
![The Europe City](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xXClL8T5/images/2a7ea7800b922ca17917b6625eacdfbfd2ebfbc6.png)

**Pyramids theme** - In them ancient people, before our era, hid a lot of mysterious treasures, which you will have to find. However, it is not so easy, as you will be waiting for a lot of obstacles and traps, which you will need to pass on the clues. Unfortunately not all the clues have survived to this day.
![Desert Pyramid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xXClL8T5/images/273cab1d0d78b80f6fa5ca28d1f12032575df011.png)

**Theme Saman Village** - This is a very dirty and poor settlements, in them houses are very small, cramped. You can find here and businesses of small size. There are also monuments, not big stores.
![The Saman Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xXClL8T5/images/6b4a6bd590363e3c98de54f8ab07c893a7c002b0.png)

**Theme Greece village** - This is a rather old civilization, which is located in the birch forest. Their houses are mostly made of birch and calcite. Small stalls are common here, among the inhabitants who are engaged in various activities.
![The Greece village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xXClL8T5/images/9f0046e80ee8c9ad87a3f1e56b570abcec9c141b.png)

village-names.title: Village Names
village-names.description: Backports modern village structures and villager designs, and generates names for villages and villagers, and other entities and structures.
village-names.body:
![Village Names banner](https://i.imgur.com/98G02wE.png "Village Names banner")

The *Village Names* mod backports modern village structures and villager skins, and assigns randomized names to villages and villagers and other structures and entities. The mod offers a lot of customization village generation and entity naming.


Some features developed over the years:
* A new village generator, able to place down road blocks other than gravel, and will even use certain backported Grass Path blocks in 1.7.
* Backported and custom [village components](https://gitgud.io/AstroTibs/VillageNames/-/wikis/village-generator/village-components)
* Highly configurable village size and components
* Highly configurable syllable pools for name generation
* Custom name signs, banners, and preferred colors for each village
* A custom item (Codex) used to generate names for supported non-village structures, obtained either from giving emeralds and iron/gold to Librarians/Cartographers, or found as chest loot
* Configurable list for entities that can receive automatic names when spawning, or names assigned when right-clicked
* Villagers with skin tones that are based on their spawn biome
* Support for a career-like profession subdivision in 1.7
* Modified villager trade pools, and added "treasure" trades for Librarians and Cartographers
* Modular biome-and-profession-based villager outfits
* Backported Cartographer villager to previous versions, and Nitwit where able
* Backported Concrete and Glazed Terracotta to previous versions
* Backported Guardian, Monuments, and Prismarine to 1.7
* Backported Igloos to 1.7 and 1.8




Here is are feature showcase videos:

[![Village Names 4 Feature Showcase](http://img.youtube.com/vi/bw0qac02ezU/0.jpg)](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bw0qac02ezU "Village Names 4 Feature Showcase")

[![Village Names 3.1 Feature Showcase](http://img.youtube.com/vi/pA67oAriBIM/0.jpg)](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pA67oAriBIM "Village Names 3.1 Feature Showcase")

![](https://i.imgur.com/g47qxf6.jpg)

WHAT IS INTEGRATED DUNGEONS AND STRUCTURES?

          Integrated Dungeons and Structures (aka IDAS) is a mod that adds heavily detailed structures using blocks and mobs from Quark, Alex’s Mobs, and Create, with optional integrated with many other mods. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make a mod that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core forge mods.   If you’re new to this mod I highly recommend locating a Labyrinth, Tinker’s Workshop, Ancient Mines or a Pillager Fortress and playing through it. Those took by FAR the most time to build and I believe they are genuinely very fun and rewarding. Good luck!   Check out my other projects! * Integrated Minecraft, the official modpack for the Integrated Structures series * Integrated Stronghold
 * Integrated Villages   Configuration and optional Integration:

For 1.16

Edit the config files
IDAS automatically detects if Ice and Fire is installed and will change some structures loot and mobs


For 1.18 and above
To enable BOP integration, download this datapack.
To enable Alex's Mobs integrated, download this datapack

To configure anything else, download this datapack

  • To change spawn rates change the spacing and separation in the structures sets. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
    Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing
  • To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure
  • To disable structures, remove all the biomes for their tag list or raise the separation and spacing to crazy high numbers
  • To improve compatibility with other structure mods, add structures to the “structure set to avoid” list in each of the worldgen/configured_structure_feature files

 

Note: When using the global datapacks mod, if you’re using both the BOP and config data packs, you have to manually make sure that the data pack for bop integration is above the config data pack.

  Features and Planned features:

Over 50 unique heavily detailed structures in the Overworld and Nether dimensions including:

-  20 unique small and detailed world building structures such as campsites, markets, animal dens, and more

-  7 Endgame level dungeons ranging from expansive dwarven mines to the desert Labyrinth to the Pillager Fortress

-  Create themed Dungeons with spinning death traps such as the Tinker's Workshop

-  15 unique houses and inns for weary travelers

 - 6 magical wizard and enchanting towers to explore

-  Sunken pirate ships

-  Villager Castles

-  Magic towers and portals to explore in the nether

-  Event based structures such as the Winter Wagon and Haunted Manor

 

Planned Features:

 

- Underground dungeon variants

- More Nether and End structures

- Join my discord to make suggestions and vote on what structures get added next!

 

If you have trouble finding one of these structures, just start typing `/locate idas` into the chat and you should find a list of all the structures. For example, typing `/locate idas:castle` will find the closest Castle to your location.

Structory is a seasonally updated, atmospheric structure datapack with light lore, including ruins, towers, cottages, graveyards, settlements, boats, and more.

![structory_banner_squashed](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/63272345/224812190-ce2bdf64-43d2-4630-9f2c-723016eb8db8.png)

## Notes
- Structory is compatible with the majority of worldgen and structure datapacks, such as Terralith or Structory: Towers
- You can add Structory to existing worlds, but structures will only generate in new chunks
- View the structures per seed using [jacobsjo](https://github.com/jacobsjo)'s [Minecraft Datapack Map](https://map.jacobsjo.eu/)

## Description
### Seasons
Alongside regular updates, Structory consistently receives themed content expansions. These feature short, ambient stories told through villagers and their structures, building on and adding to the structures already found throughout the world. 

Season 1 brought the Ruins update. Deep inside the swamps, the **Mangrove Ruins** can be found... but if you dare venture into a colder climate, you may stumble upon the **Taiga Ruins**. What stories are these old structures trying to tell? Season 2 brought the Harvest update. Legend says evil witches can be found in the **Old Manor**, brewing something mysterious. but if you wander too far, you could find yourself trapped in a rare **Graveyard**.

### Add-Ons
Separate from its content expansions, Structory will have add-ons which can be used either in conjunction with Structory, or as its own standalone datapack. This allows players and modpack creators to dynamically add or remove parts of Structory to fit their own taste and playstyle. For example, see [Structory: Towers](https://github.com/Stardust-Labs-MC/Structory-Towers)!

**![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/CT_Overhauled_Village/BH_CT_HEADER.webp)** **![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/CT_Overhauled_Village/BH_CT_BANNER1.webp)** **ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village (CTOV) is a mod that adds new and improved villages and pillager outposts to Minecraft.** It is available for both Forge and Fabric, and it works with most world-generation and structure mods. CTOV adds 23 village variants and 14 pillager outpost variants, each of which is tailored to the terrain, theme, and biome of your Minecraft world. CTOV will not be backported beyond 1.18.2 for the mod version and 1.17 for the datapack version. This means that if you are playing an older version of Minecraft, you will not be able to use CTOV.
FAQs 1. **Is it safe to update CTOV to a newer version?** Yes, it is safe to update CTOV to a newer version. However, if you do experience any problems, please let the mod author know so that they can fix them. 2. **Is it safe to add CTOV to an already existing world?** Yes, it is safe to add CTOV to an already existing world. However, the new structures will only spawn in newly generated chunks. 3. **Is this mod for Forge or Fabric/Quilt?** CTOV is available for all three mod loaders: Forge, Fabric, and Quilt. 4. **How can I locate the new structures?** To locate the new structures, you can use the `/locate` command. For 1.18.2, you would use the following command: > /locate ctov:\[structure\_from\_list\]
For 1.19+, you would use the following command: >  /locate structure ctov:[structure_from_list]
The `[structure_from_list]` part of the command is the name of the structure that you want to locate. You can find a list of all the available structures in the CTOV documentation. 5. **Does CTOV modify existing vanilla structures?** The only structures that are modified by CTOV are vanilla villages in older versions. In newer versions, CTOV creates its own structures that are separate from vanilla villages. 6. **What about the loot of these structures?** The vast majority of structures use vanilla loot tables for better mod compatibility. However, they also use some custom loot tables to integrate said structures into the world better. You will still find pillager outpost loot in pillager outposts, profession chests in villages, as well as bells, workstations, etc., but you may also find new stuff like food, armour, and other goodies. 7. **How can I report bugs/issues/suggestions?** To report bugs, issues, or suggestions, please go to the CTOV GitHub repo and create an issue. You can also message the mod author on Discord. 8. **Can I include CTOV in my modpack?** Yes, you can include CTOV in your modpack. However, please be sure to give credit to the mod author and provide a link to their page. 9. **Can I have CTOV for 1.x.x, please?** If it's lower than 1.18.2, no. Please don't ask this question. They are doing this as a hobby and do not want to be paid for their work. I hope this answers all of your questions.
**![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/CT_Overhauled_Village/BH_CT_BANNER4.webp)** ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village (CTOV) is compatible with most world-generation and structure mods. Mods that add new villagers will need compatibility packs. Here are some more details about the compatibility of CTOV with other mods: - **World-generation mods:** CTOV relies on vanilla biome Tags, so almost all world-generation mods like Terralith, Oh Biome You'll Go, and Biomes O'plenty will have appropriate CTOV villages in their biomes. - **Structure mods:** Various structure mods like Town&Tower and Repurposed structures also work well with CTOV. However, it is important to exercise caution when using too many mods, as this can cause instability. The same applies to Better Village. - **Other mods:** Any other mod that doesn't affect villages and villagers will be compatible by default. - Mods that add new villagers will need compatibility packs, which can be found on the CurseForge website. ## WHAT IS INTEGRATED VILLAGES?
 Integrated Villages is the third mod in the Integrated Structures series. Not only does it completely overhaul the boring old Minecraft Villages with tons of heavily detailed houses to explore, but it integrates Supplementaries/Quark decorations and Create mod doors, puzzles, traps, and over 30 other mods. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make mods that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core mods.

## Configuration and optional Integration

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
By default IV disables vanilla villages from spawning, you can change this in the config file.

To configure anything else, download this [https://curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/integrated-villages-configuration](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/integrated-villages-configuration)

To change spawn rates change the spacing and separation in the structures sets. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing

To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure

To disable structures, remove the structures from the structure set file

To improve compatibility with other structure mods, add structure SETS to the “structure set to avoid” list in each of the tags/worldgen/structure_set files

Configuration for what workstations appear from mods you have installed will be coming soon!

</details>

better-archeology.body:
![Better Archeology Title](https://i.imgur.com/KG3zJMU.png)
![Life & Death Update](https://i.imgur.com/MBQksdy.png)

With the theme of archeology being introduced in the Minecraft 1.20 "Trails & Tales" Update, it has quickly become clear that Mojang sadly only took a small step into the big world that is archeology.

It is our goal with this mod to improve upon the mechanics introduced in the update and expand the minecraft universe with new stuff to discover while staying true to the nature of the game.

We also plan to regularly update the mod to newer versions and provide new content in the weeks to follow.

For more in-depth info, visit our [Wiki](https://github.com/Pandarix/BetterArcheology/wiki)!
